note: Ink on the land. Engraver-style marks that follow the ground height: thin contour lines, soft hatching on the shaded side of slopes, a cool shade on the downhill side, a faint paper grain and a slow wash on flat land. All numbers are guesses, tuned here. Anything but a plain true for 'enabled' is off, and off means the ground material is exactly as before. Distances are metres from the camera.
